class.name: BindingSlot
class.brief_description: A detached snapshot of one editable physical control.
class.description: Obtain a slot from [Rebinding]. A slot identifies its original [Controls] attachment. Read a fresh snapshot after editing. Mutating a returned event does not affect gameplay.

members.member: The logical action receiving input from this slot.
The [enum Rebinding.BindingDevice] value used for capture.
The optional game-authored slot label, such as Forward. Empty when none was authored.
A new detached copy of the assigned physical event, or [code]null[/code] when unbound.
The unique, stable slot identifier within the layout.
A human-readable description of the assigned control, or Unbound.
